title: Production systems that changed throughput, latency, or reliability.
summary: I build production systems for operations-heavy teams where throughput, realtime feedback, and delivery reliability have to hold up under live usage.
cases_subtitle: Three shipped systems where the architecture had to remove delay, backlog, or failure-prone manual work.

cases.title: Automated Fundraiser Acknowledgment at Scale
cases.summary: Replaced a manual outsourced thank-you workflow with browser automation that could keep up with high-volume fundraiser traffic.
cases.outcome: Roughly 12x per-operator throughput with 72 concurrent workers, clearing a persistent backlog.
highlights: Worker-pool automation pushed browser acknowledgments to 72 concurrent jobs
Template handling and operator-only steps moved out of the daily workflow
Improved response speed enough to lift fundraiser chat engagement

cases.title: Realtime Fundraiser Creation + Donation Signal Pipeline
cases.summary: Built a realtime fundraiser creation and donation pipeline so teams could act on live signals instead of waiting for delayed files.
cases.outcome: Eliminated a 48-hour reporting lag and surfaced donation context in realtime for operations teams.
highlights: Fundraiser creation and donation intake were wired into one live pipeline
Operators saw donation context immediately instead of waiting for delayed exports

cases.title: Custom Substack Publishing Pipeline in Rust
cases.summary: Built a Rust monorepo that connected CMS events, queued workers, and publishing automation for Substack-oriented content operations.
cases.outcome: Delivered a deterministic pipeline from Directus webhooks through queued workers to publish actions.
highlights: Directus webhooks fed typed event routing into queued Rust workers
Publishing actions stayed deterministic from inbound event to Substack delivery
Queue-backed publishing flow with custom Substack integration
